title: Stellar Transcendence
description: Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

puzzle.goal: In a plasma hotter than any stellar core, atoms lose their electrons. Balance ionisation against recombination in thermal equilibrium: the ratio of ionised to neutral atoms times the electron density is set by the electron's thermal phase-space density, the statistical weights g of the two states, and a Boltzmann factor of the ionisation energy χ.
puzzle.name: Saha ionisation equation
puzzle.expr: ( 2 * π * me * kB * T / h ^ 2 ) ^ 1.5 * exp ( - χ / ( kB * T ) ) / ne
puzzle.ask: For hydrogen 2g1/g0 = 1. Find the ionisation ratio n_i/n_0 at the temperature and electron density below.
puzzle.method: Apply the Boltzmann distribution to the ion + free electron state; the free electron's states are counted by phase-space volume divided by h³.
